tasks.prompt: Review the code in fixtures/purposes/review/ and write your findings to fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md, one finding per line with the line number. Do not change the source. Do not run git.
gate: test -s fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md || { echo 'REVIEW.md is missing or empty'; exit 1; }
grep -qiE '(^|[^0-9])11([^0-9]|$)|off-by-one' fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md || { echo 'review does not identify the off-by-one at line 11'; exit 1; }
grep -qiE '(^|[^0-9])19([^0-9]|$)|unchecked error' fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md || { echo 'review does not identify the unchecked error at line 19'; exit 1; }
grep -qiE '(^|[^0-9])31([^0-9]|$)|race' fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md || { echo 'review does not identify the race at line 31'; exit 1; }
git diff --quiet HEAD -- fixtures/purposes/review/review.go || { echo 'review.go was changed'; exit 1; }

tasks.prompt: Refactor fixtures/purposes/refactor/dup.go to remove the duplication without changing behaviour. Keep the exported Sum and Mean functions and their signatures, empty-input error, and input slices unchanged. Keep one shared validation using the line if len(values) == 0 {. Do not change checks/. Do not run git.
gate: git diff --quiet HEAD -- fixtures/purposes/refactor/checks || { echo 'the checks were changed'; exit 1; }
cp fixtures/purposes/refactor/checks/dup_test.go.txt fixtures/purposes/refactor/dup_test.go || { echo 'could not install the hidden test'; exit 1; }
go test -count=1 ./fixtures/purposes/refactor/ || { echo 'Sum or Mean changed behaviour'; exit 1; }
[ "$(grep -cF 'if len(values) == 0 {' fixtures/purposes/refactor/dup.go)" -eq 1 ] || { echo 'expected exactly one shared empty-input validation'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'func Sum\b' fixtures/purposes/refactor/dup.go || { echo 'exported Sum is missing'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'func Mean\b' fixtures/purposes/refactor/dup.go || { echo 'exported Mean is missing'; exit 1; }

tasks.prompt: Write a plan, as fixtures/purposes/plan/PLAN-ANSWER.md, for adding rate limiting to the handler in fixtures/purposes/plan/handler.go. Use at most 400 words, name the handler function, give at least three numbered or bulleted steps, and include testing. Do not run git.
gate: test -f fixtures/purposes/plan/PLAN-ANSWER.md || { echo 'PLAN-ANSWER.md is missing'; exit 1; }
w=$(wc -w < fixtures/purposes/plan/PLAN-ANSWER.md); [ "$w" -le 400 ] || { echo "too long: $w words"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'StatusHandler' fixtures/purposes/plan/PLAN-ANSWER.md || { echo 'plan does not name StatusHandler'; exit 1; }
[ "$(grep -cE '^[0-9]+\.|^- ' fixtures/purposes/plan/PLAN-ANSWER.md)" -ge 3 ] || { echo 'plan needs at least three numbered or bulleted steps'; exit 1; }
grep -qi 'test' fixtures/purposes/plan/PLAN-ANSWER.md || { echo 'plan does not mention a test'; exit 1; }

tasks.prompt: Add a GitHub Actions workflow at fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml that runs go vet and go test on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest for the module in fixtures/purposes/ops. Run the commands in that module directory. Change nothing else under the fixture. Do not run git.
gate: test -f fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml || { echo 'ci.yml is missing'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'ubuntu-latest' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml || { echo 'ci.yml is missing ubuntu-latest'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'windows-latest' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml || { echo 'ci.yml is missing windows-latest'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'go vet' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml || { echo 'ci.yml is missing go vet'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'go test' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml || { echo 'ci.yml is missing go test'; exit 1; }
grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*on:' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml || { echo 'ci.yml is missing on:'; exit 1; }
git diff --quiet HEAD -- fixtures/purposes/ops ':(exclude)fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml' || { echo 'ops fixture changed outside ci.yml'; exit 1; }

extra=$(git ls-files --others -- fixtures/purposes/ops ':(exclude)fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml') || { echo 'could not check new ops files'; exit 1; }; [ -z "$extra" ] || { echo "unexpected new ops files: $extra"; exit 1; }
